column1: MF02.1 - Create Mission from Ready Assessment

column2: Create inspection mission from valid Ready PreMissionAssessment
column3:
1. Authenticate as Manager
2. POST /api/v1/missions with readyAssessmentId, towers, priority
column4: HTTP 201 Created; mission created (Draft/Assigned) and source assessment marked Completed

column2: Update mission target towers and resolve mission inspection scope
column3:
1. PUT /api/v1/missions/{id}/towers with valid towerIds in region
2. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/scope/resolve
column4: HTTP 200 OK; target towers updated and inspection scope resolved

column2: Reject mission creation if target tower belongs to different RegionId
column3: 1. PUT /api/v1/missions/{id}/towers with towerId from another Region
column4: HTTP 403 Forbidden with TOWER_OUTSIDE_REGION_OR_SCOPE

column2: Update mission priority level (Normal / High / Emergency)
column3: 1. PATCH /api/v1/missions/{id}/priority with priority=Emergency
column4: HTTP 200 OK; mission priority updated and reflected in GET /api/v1/missions/{id}

column2: Assign active Inspector in same RegionId to inspection mission
column3: 1. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/assignments with userId (Inspector) and isRequired=true
column4: HTTP 201 / 200 OK; assignment persisted and Inspector listed in mission members

column2: Reassign mission member to another conflict-free Inspector
column3: 1. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/assignments/reassign with previousAssignmentId and newUserId
column4: HTTP 200 OK; old assignment replaced and new booking created cleanly

column2: Reject assigning an inactive or already-assigned user to the mission
column3: 1. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/assignments with suspended userId or duplicate userId
column4: HTTP 400 / 409 Conflict with ASSIGNEE_INACTIVE or ASSIGNEE_ALREADY_ASSIGNED

column2: Block removing the last required mission member
column3: 1. Attempt to remove sole required Inspector assignment without replacement
column4: HTTP 400 / 409 Conflict with REQUIRED_MEMBER_REQUIRED

column1: MF02.3 - UAV Resource Allocation & Conflict Check

column2: Assign Available Healthy UAV and run /check-resource-conflicts
column3:
1. POST /api/v1/missions/check-resource-conflicts
2. PUT /api/v1/missions/{id}/drone with droneId
column4: HTTP 200 OK; HasConflict=false and UAV paired with mission

column2: Allow re-booking UAV slot after prior cancelled mission soft-deleted bookings
column3:
1. Cancel Mission 1 (IsDeleted=true on bookings)
2. Dispatch Mission 2 with same UAV & time window
column4: HTTP 200 / 201 OK; soft-deleted ResourceBookings excluded from overlap constraint
column15: DEF-002: PostgreSQL exclusion index lacked WHERE IsDeleted=false until migration 20261031165258 verified in R3

column2: Reject allocating UAV already reserved in overlapping window or Critical health
column3: 1. PUT /api/v1/missions/{id2}/drone using already-booked droneId or Critical drone
column4: HTTP 409 Conflict with DRONE_ALREADY_RESERVED, RESOURCE_BOOKING_CONFLICT, or DRONE_CRITICAL_HEALTH

column1: MF02.4 - Mission Dispatch & Atomic Resource Booking

column2: Dispatch mission and atomically lock ResourceBookings for UAV and Inspector
column3:
1. Ensure members & drone assigned
2. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/confirm as Manager
column4: HTTP 200 OK; Mission transitions to Assigned/PendingAcceptance and ResourceBookings committed

column2: Prevent concurrent mission dispatch race via RowVersion concurrency check
column3: 1. Send two simultaneous dispatch/update requests with stale mission version
column4: First succeeds (200 OK); second fails with 409 Conflict (MISSION_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT)

column2: Verify NotificationService overdue reminder & SignalR broadcast on dispatch
column3:
1. Dispatch mission
2. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/remind
column4: HTTP 200 OK; notification record created and pushed via RealtimeNotificationService

column2: Block starting mission when required Inspector has not accepted assignment
column3: 1. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/start while required member is still PendingAcceptance
column4: HTTP 409 Conflict with REQUIRED_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING

column2: Assigned Inspector accepts mission assignment in Portal
column3:
1. Authenticate as assigned Inspector
2. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/assignments/accept
column4: HTTP 200 OK; assignment accepted and mission transitions Ready for field execution

column2: Postpone or reschedule mission and atomically release/shift ResourceBookings
column3: 1. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/postpone with reason (or PUT update schedule window)
column4: HTTP 200 OK; mission transitions Postponed and active ResourceBookings updated/freed atomically
column15: DEF-003: Postpone/reschedule left stale booking windows in R1; transactional fix verified R2-R3

column2: Cancel mission with reason and automatically release booked UAV & Inspector
column3:
1. POST /api/v1/missions/{id}/cancel with reason
2. Query /api/v1/drones/available
column4: HTTP 200 OK; MissionStatus = Cancelled and UAV returned to available pool
